mapper.sql: v.id, v.code_value, v.value_name, v.description, v.sort_order, v.used_yn, v.created_at, v.updated_at, g.id AS g_id, g.code_id AS g_code_id, g.code_name AS g_code_name, g.description AS g_description, g.used_yn AS g_used_yn, g.created_at AS g_created_at, g.updated_at AS g_updated_at
FROM com_code_value v JOIN com_code_group g ON g.id = v.group_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO com_code_value (group_id, code_value, value_name, description, sort_order, used_yn, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{group.id}, #{codeValue}, #{valueName}, #{description}, #{sortOrder}, #{used}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
